integration_scope: claim ledger only; draft PR214, experimental analyses and v0.5 manuscript not merged

claims.statement: Historical near-colony marine conditions have a temperature–sea-ice principal component and a distinct salinity-dominated component.
claims.inference_boundary: PCA components are mathematically orthogonal, not experimentally separable causal mechanisms

claims.statement: Adelie satellite-reconstructed optical guano δ15N is positively associated with same-season coastal salinity conditional on sea ice, ocean temperature, image timing, site and region×season.
claims.source_region_slope_directions: Victoria Land and Wilkes Land positive; southwest Antarctic Peninsula negative; northeast Antarctic Peninsula close to zero
claims.inference_boundary: Isotope is an optical proxy, not a measured fish fraction. Region-level CI includes zero, isotope baseline unresolved and future-exposure placebo remains; do not claim causal prey switching or universal Antarctic positive slope.

claims.statement: Among genuinely revisited fixed-known Adélie colony rosters, the nest-count-weighted nesting location shifted south between 1991–2000 and 2011–2020.
claims.inference_boundary: The same colony coordinates are fixed; this is reweighting among recorded nests, not tracked dispersal or proven sea-ice niche tracking. Rosters overlap, not independent replications.

claims.statement: In six exactly source/citation/method-matched long-term colony series, the gentoo-to-Adelie observed nest ratio increased in every series, while the actually observed two-species nest subtotal increased in five.
claims.inference_boundary: Only two source regions; relative species restructuring is not a competitive replacement mechanism and a changing ratio does not imply declining total nests.

claims.statement: Three selected source CMIP6 models project widespread surface freshening, while the same models disagree on geographical sea-ice and salinity change coupling.
claims.inference_boundary: Only 3 selected models, each one member; model agreement is not probability. Nest-median weights are fixed historical source proxies, NOT future nests. CMIP6 physical season and ocean grid differ from the isotope model; no future δ15N or breeding forecast.

rejected_as_unverified_main_claims: warming causes individual Adélie southward migration
future SSP-to-colony nest-count or extinction predictions
historical 265-series climate coefficient not reproduced from frozen original MAPPPD source
